simultaneousIndependentActions.rule: When simultaneous parts cannot be represented as chords, write the parts successively and join them without spaces using an in-accord sign.

ordering.midiCaveat: Standard MIDI track/channel identity does not preserve print staff/hand identity; H4 does not invent a treble/bass assignment.

octaveAfterSign.rule: The first note after an in-accord or measure-division sign requires an octave mark; a measure following one that ends with an in-accord also starts with an octave mark.

fullMeasure.equalValueRequirement: each side must contain exactly one full measure of note values
fullMeasure.transcriberAddedRest: permitted when an implied rest is needed; each such added rest must be preceded by dot 5

partMeasure.equalValueRequirement: each side of the part-measure in-accord must contain exactly the same total note value
partMeasure.incompleteMeasureRestriction: only a part-measure in-accord may be used for an incomplete measure

crossedVoices.midiCaveat: MIDI does not preserve print stem direction, so H4 cannot claim original crossed-voice ordering from source MIDI alone.

midiReconstructionPolicy.independentOnsetOverlap: derive simultaneous actions only after a deterministic voice-partition profile is separately frozen
midiReconstructionPolicy.preferredFirstImplementation: full-measure in-accord for complete derived measures
midiReconstructionPolicy.addedRestRequirement: derived rests inserted only to equalize full-measure sides must be explicitly marked as transcriber-added with dot 5
midiReconstructionPolicy.incompleteMeasure: do not use full-measure in-accord; part-measure semantics are required
prohibited: using newline-separated source parts as a substitute for in-accord
omitting the dot-5 marker on transcriber-added in-accord rests

evidence.interpretation: two terminal ASCII LF bytes outside all declared SMF chunks

compatibilityPolicy.accept: terminal ASCII whitespace only after all declared track chunks
compatibilityPolicy.semanticEffect: none; bytes are outside declared MIDI chunks and are not parsed as MIDI events
compatibilityPolicy.extraMTrkBeyondHeaderCount: INVALID_MIDI_FILE until a separately frozen compatibility rule exists

implementationGates.name: generic MIDI in-accord reconstruction profile
implementationGates.missingDecision: deterministic treble/bass-direction policy for MIDI parts that lack print staff/hand semantics
